_help: One entry per bullet. 'summary' is the sentence shown on the page. 'context', 'whatIDid' and 'result' are optional: leave them as empty strings and they will not appear. An entry with all three empty shows as a plain line with no expand control.

items.summary: Manage workplace operations across four offices (New York, Stamford, Chicago, Austin) for a firm of roughly 250 people.
Led four office buildouts and relocations, from planning through move-in.
Built a vendor tracking system that streamlined spend and contract management.
Negotiated meaningful annual savings across vendor contracts.
Coordinated logistics for investor roadshows and non-deal roadshows, including transportation, meals, and scheduling.
